tagline: The set every fan wants sealed
sector: Officially licensed sports collector cards (continental club football tournament)
founded_place_size: touring competition, Western Europe and North America; canonical context for the repeat-client series.
about: Continental Cup 2026 Collector Card Programme is the repeat client for this benchmark series. The canonical client context is touring competition, Western Europe and North America, and this commission covers phase 1: collector-card portrait finishing.
audience: Collectors aged 16 to 45 who buy officially licensed cup sets, know a licensed release from a fan-made one at a glance, and expect deep, saturated, high-contrast presentation worthy of a marquee tournament.
price_positioning: Premium licensed collector tier. Pack twelve dollars, sealed box ninety-five, featured cards trading roughly 30 to 120 dollars secondary. The treatment is deep and saturated with real floodlit blacks, one dominant player per card, type set large and confident. Never a flat, bright community-league sheet, and never a neon gaming poster.

palette.name: Pitch Deep Navy (retailer display and card field)

typography: A confident licensed-sport system: a strong condensed or wide display face for player names and the set masthead, paired with a clean, sturdy sans for squad numbers, position, honours line and data. Numerals must read cleanly at small card sizes.
voice: Bold, official and celebratory without slang. Speaks with the authority of a sanctioned tournament: it names the players, states the honours and lets the floodlit imagery carry the drama.
brand_assets_status: The brand files are largely lost. The studio that designed last year's card has closed, and all that survives is the flat file the printer ran, whose layout the retailers already recognise and want kept. The competition crest was never held as artwork at all: the only reference is a daylight photograph of the embroidered patch on an official's sleeve. The recovered mark and the rebuilt card layout therefore have to be reconstructed from those remnants and carried forward as the programme's working assets.
values: Authenticity of the licence above all. Depict the real featured players and the real competition mark faithfully, print the licensing copy exactly as supplied, and hold one premium look across print and store so the set reads as sanctioned, not imitated.
